title: Tell the agent its job
name: P0.4 · Tell the agent its job

jtbd.situation: The agent exists on a preset with a voice. Its prompt is empty, it has no first line, and nothing is set for the moment the language model fails. Sam knows the task and wants the agent to do it in the next test
jtbd.wantsTo: write the prompt where the builder opens, see the `{{variables}}` the prompt uses and give each one a default when it makes sense, set the greeting and the failure message behind one door, and hear the result
jtbd.soThat: callers get the job done in one session, and nothing the agent says aloud is left to chance
happySteps: Prompt & knowledge opens with the prompt editor first.
Sam writes the prompt. {{variables}} show as chips, each with an optional default.
Sam opens Greeting to set the first line, when it plays, its delay and the failure message.
Optional: Sam says what a successful session looks like in Analysis (P1.9).

rainyTitles.title: The agent speaks first but the greeting is empty
Sam tests with unsaved prompt edits

research.finding: Owed (only if a rainy path has no evidence at all): No vendor shot shows where the failure message lives. Capture it, plus an empty-prompt save and a variable with no value at test. Own before and after shots: research/04-greeting-filler/05-shots.
